title: Engram Harness Task Specification v1
description: Schema for task specifications governing isolated agent execution in the Engram harness.

schema_version.description: Schema version identifier for the task specification.

task_id.description: Unique identifier for this task run.

target_sha.description: Target Git commit SHA (40-character lowercase hexadecimal).

base_sha.description: Base Git commit SHA (40-character lowercase hexadecimal).

allowed_capabilities.description: List of authorized sandbox capabilities granted to the writer.

required_checks.description: List of approved check IDs that must be run and pass.

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum execution time in seconds before task fails closed.

allowed_paths.description: Optional list of repo-relative paths the task is permitted to inspect or modify.

protected_paths.description: Optional list of protected paths that cannot be modified.

metadata.description: Optional arbitrary metadata for audit logging.
